title: Finish review #828: which inventory copy score.py reads and whether a wrong literal or locator would fail (findings F2, F3)
body:
## Goal
Positive-control thread (#763 f4), step 3, finishing the partial review #828. #828 already confirmed (do not repeat): artifact hash matches key and inventory; A0001 `20008000` at `/Library/@LVVersion` line 2 and A0002 `NI.LV.All.SourceOnly` at `/Library/Property[4]/@Name` line 6 match plan and inventory (F1). Its pins are staged as `.session/inputs/828-pins.txt`. Do not re-hash files or re-derive literals.

Open items to close: F2 (would a control fail on a wrong literal or a wrong locator?) and F3 (which inventory copy `benchmark/scripts/score.py` reads). Report, do not fix: write no repository file. Expected gain: a final CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR verdict for starting step 4 on the first lines of `.session/report.md`, with the exact file score.py reads and the function and line that compares value and locator.

No session can run LabVIEW; make no claim about how LabVIEW interprets any value.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Check `.session/exports/manifest.json` and confirm the #828 report and `.session/inputs/828-pins.txt` are available; record the main commit you review in `.session/artifacts/pins-0193.txt` with the SHA-256 of `benchmark/scripts/score.py`.
- [ ] F3: name the exact inventory path score.py reads for the library specialty case (file and line in score.py), and whether `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json` is that file or a copy.
- [ ] F2: from the code, state with line references whether the scorer compares the literal, the locator, or both; optionally confirm with a mutation run on a temporary copy outside the repository (`python3 -B`), never by editing a repository file.
- [ ] F4: state whether the locator scheme names differ in a way the scorer checks.
- [ ] Write detailed evidence to `.session/artifacts/review-0193.md`; findings with severity in `.session/report.md`; verdict on the first lines.
- [ ] Run `git status --porcelain` at the end and report that it is clean.

## Verification
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json')); c=d['claims']; assert c['A0001']['value']=='20008000' and c['A0002']['value']=='NI.LV.All.SourceOnly'; print('key unchanged: OK')"

## Context
- #828 report (staged via exports) lists F1-F4 and what next; its session lost Grep/Bash mid-session, so save artifacts early.
- Bytecode trap: importing anything under `benchmark/scripts/` needs `python3 -B` and `sys.dont_write_bytecode = True` (#785).
- score.py writes `benchmark/results/challenges.json`; do not run it in the repository tree in a way that rewrites that file.

## Budget
Read: the #828 report, `.session/inputs/828-pins.txt`, `benchmark/scripts/score.py` (Grep for `reference_inventory`, `library-specialty`, `locator` first, then read only the matching functions), `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json`, and the inventory file score.py reads. Do not read `benchmark/results/**` whole or `journal/**`. Short command output only. Write the report early and refine it.
